title: The Unofficial Semester
author: E. M. Delacroix
blurb: Beatrix Okonkwo, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must save the tradition that made the town, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
